14703292.description: Connorstictic acid is an organic compound in the structural class of chemicals known as depsidones. It occurs as a secondary metabolite in many lichen species in several genera.

15102780.name: Buscaline

16162108.name: Little gastrin I

16217788.name: Cuprospinel

22796092.name: Estradiol dibenzoate

23001916.name: Dichlorofluoroiodomethane

23236028.name: Iodosyl trifluoride

24802108.name: 4-MeO-DiPT
24802108.description: 4-MeO-DiPT, also known as 4-methoxy-N,N-diisopropyltryptamine, is a novel serotonin receptor modulator of the tryptamine family related to known psychedelic tryptamines like psilocin and 5-MeO-DMT.

24810684.name: Remeglurant

24847804.name: Ipratropium bromide/salbutamol

24941628.name: Decarbamoylsaxitoxin

44397500.name: JWH-203

102058172.name: Methyl homodaphniphyllate
102058172.description: Methyl homodaphniphyllate is a polycyclic molecule belonging to the substance class terpenoid-alkaloids, of which it is the subtype Daphniphyllum-alkaloid, a type of triterpenoid-alkaloid.

121008956.name: 2,3,4,6-Tetramethoxyphenethylamine
121008956.description: 2,3,4,6-Tetramethoxyphenethylamine , also known as TeMPEA-2, is a drug of the phenethylamine family related to the psychedelic drug mescaline .

125181244.name: 5F-PCN

129858236.name: JWH-185

135449020.name: Spinochrome B

135565884.name: Zanubrutinib

139030972.name: Water blue
139030972.description: Water blue, also known as aniline blue, Acid blue 22, Soluble Blue 3M, Marine Blue V, or C.I.

156150588.name: CE-158

156445116.name: Suzetrigine

158541116.name: Zirconium iodate

900000060.name: A-NK

900000188.name: Apolizumab

900000316.name: BriLife

900000444.name: Cerocene

900002108.name: Ugr 9-1
